correctness.rationale: For each n>=5 the proof establishes the exact equivariant edge-set model of the Lovasz neighborhood complex and derives reduced Lefschetz traces by signed chain orientations. Boolean Mobius inversion over vertex-cycle supports gives the excluded-support orbit-weight (-1)^c(f^2-3f+1), hence the top homology trace sign(sigma)*(f^2-3f+1), using the independently published n-4 concentration theorem arxiv:1802.05848. The polynomial equals the sign twist of the sum of S^(n-2,2) and wedge^2 Std, so partition transpose gives the stated two distinct irreducibles. No trivial or sign components implies S_n and A_n rational quotient acyclicity via finite-group averaging and barycentric subdivision. Supplementary independent exact tests cover all 85 conjugacy classes n=5..9, direct oriented-face trace n=5,6, and class inner products; finite tests are not used as proof for all n. No integral equivariant or homotopy equivalence is asserted.

originality.rationale: The accepted claim is the full natural symmetric-group rational homology character and multiplicity-one Specht decomposition for every n>=5, plus rational quotient acyclicity. Nilakantan and Singh (arXiv:1802.05848, Theorem 1.3) establish only nonequivariant homotopy and rank; the previously indexed published-finding corpus six-point calculation gives precisely the n=6 special case, which is excluded as an isolated novelty. Babson et al. (arXiv:math/9705219) compute another graph complex (not two-connected) with homology in degree 2n-5, not the two-isolated-vertices complex. Braun and Zeckner (arXiv:1102.1984) concern stable rather than ordinary Kneser graphs. Targeted searches for equivariant formulations, characters, partitions, quotient invariants, and support-edge graph descriptions found no all-n result. This is best-knowledge originality, not certification of publication priority.
residual_risks: The previously indexed six-point exact-record full text was not available; only the recoverable title and summary were read, so a broader theorem in that document cannot be excluded categorically.
A separately published or unindexed all-n equivariant formula may exist; search noncoverage does not prove priority.
Rational representations alone do not determine integral module structure or quotient integral homology.

value.rationale: For a natural infinite family with a previously known nonequivariant sphere-wedge classification, the complete S_n action was previously identified in the available records only at n=6. A universal fixed-point polynomial and two irreducible Specht constituents distinguish actual equivariant topology in every n>=5 and yield an exact global quotient-acyclicity phenomenon. The graph model with >=2 isolated labels gives a reusable general character-counting mechanism and a nontrivial representation-stability pattern. The n=6 special case and known Betti numbers are excluded as standalone new claims.
